title: A Tree Grows in Brooklyn
author: Betty Smith
summary: Francie Nolan grows up poor in early twentieth-century Williamsburg, Brooklyn, finding refuge in books while her loving but unreliable father and hard-working mother struggle to get by.
readIf: you like tender, detailed coming-of-age novels about family and hardship.
skipIf: you want a tightly plotted story rather than an episodic childhood.
